ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:5 white-to-black pixel ratio across the visible ventral fluke surface; high-intensity pixels are predominantly confined to the distal lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Significant white contiguous region on the left distal tip containing dark internal mottling. Smaller, isolated white region on the right distal tip near the trailing edge corner. The central 80% of the fluke width is comprised of uniform low-intensity dark pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge boundary with continuous micro-serrations. Right lobe displays at least three distinct V-shaped notches (~8-15 pixel depth). Left lobe displays a coarser, more jagged linear boundary with irregular pixel oscillations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to slightly rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated brownish-rust colored pixel cluster at the apex of the right distal tip. Multiple small white circular pixel clusters (~2-4px diameter) localized along the distal third of the right lobe trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-contrast gray pixel tracks visible on the medial-dark section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible brownish-orange biological growth/protrusion at the extreme right tip. Deep irregular notched defect on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately 65% of the way from the center to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct high-contrast boundary between the solid dark pigment and the white-mottled tips.
